content_sections.text: The venue is given in the official notification (see the link below).

content_sections.text: Walk-in date: 3 December 2026, reporting at 10:00 AM Vacancies: 5 How to apply: Attend the walk-in interview Pay: Consolidated remuneration as per approved scales by CA at SPAV (separate for P.G. and Ph.D degree holders) Fee: No application fee is mentioned in the notification Place: Vijayawada

rows.school_of_planning_and_architecture_vija: Consolidated remuneration as per approved scales by CA at SPAV (separate for P.G. and Ph.D degree holders)

Bachelor's Degree in Architecture/Planning/Technology/Engineering and Master Degree in Planning with First Class or equivalent in either degree; OR Master Degree in Economics/Geography/Sociology and Master Degree in Planning with First Class equivalent in both Master degrees (First Class equivalence = minimum 60% aggregate)

content_sections.heading: SPA Vijayawada Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 10/SPAV/Con Fac./Rect./26-27 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download SPA Vijayawada notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture/Planning/Technology/Engineering and Master Degree in Planning with First Class or equivalent either in Bachelors or Master Degree; OR Master Degree in Economics/Geography/Sociology and Master Degree in Planning with First Class equivalent in BOTH the two Master degrees; Equivalence of First Class is a minimum of 60% in aggregate, if class or division is not awarded Experience: Desirable: One (01) year experience in teaching and/or research/or industry in a reputed organization Other conditions: Candidates with foreign university degrees must produce an Equivalence Certificate from Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi Desirable: One (01) year experience in teaching and/or research/or industry in a reputed organization Specialization in Transport Planning, Urban and Regional Planning and Environmental Planning in PG level of M.Plan Papers presented at Conference and/or in referred journals

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated Remuneration for P.G. Degree holders and Ph.D Degree holders as per the approved scales by CA at SPAV from time to time. Purely temporary and purely on contract basis Initially for a tenure of six months Extendable from time to time, depending on requirement and satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: How Will SPA Vijayawada Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Verification of Documents Walk-in Interview (may include a Power Point Presentation of up to 5 slides) Verification of documents on 03-12-2026 before the walk-in interview Candidate may be required to make a Power Point Presentation on a topic of their interest during the interview, maximum 5 slides

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: UG, PG and Ph.D Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets Experience Certificates CoA/ITPI Registration, if applicable, Identity proof issued by GoI SSC/DoB certificate & Passport size photograph Photocopies of all documents on qualifications, experience etc. with the filled application

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SPA Vijayawada Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.spav.ac.in. Fill in the application form. Submit the filled application with photocopies of documents on qualifications, experience etc. at document verification before the walk-in interview on 03-12-2026. Bring original documents for verification.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the interview Vacancies are likely to increase or decrease as per requirement at the sole discretion of the institute

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for SPA Vijayawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 3 December 2026, and candidates report at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SPA Vijayawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies for Assistant Professor.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for SPA Vijayawada Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 3 December 2026 at 10:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration as per approved scales by CA at SPAV (separate for P.G. and Ph.D degree holders).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Bachelor's Degree in Architecture/Planning/Technology/Engineering and Master Degree in Planning with First Class or equivalent in either degree; OR Master Degree in Economics/Geography/Sociology and Master Degree in Planning with First Class equivalent in both Master degrees (First Class equivalence = minimum 60% aggregate).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates with foreign university degrees must produce an Equivalence Certificate from Association of Indian Universities (AIU), New Delhi.

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Verification of Documents. Walk-in Interview (may include a Power Point Presentation of up to 5 slides). Verification of documents on 03-12-2026 before the walk-in interview. Candidate may be required to make a Power Point Presentation on a topic of their interest during the interview, maximum 5 slides.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and purely on contract basis. Initially for a tenure of six months. Extendable from time to time, depending on requirement and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Vijayawada.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: UG, PG and Ph.D Degree Certificates, Marks Sheets; Experience Certificates; CoA/ITPI Registration, if applicable, Identity proof issued by GoI; SSC/DoB certificate & Passport size photograph; Photocopies of all documents on qualifications, experience etc. with the filled application.
